integrity: Exact explicit finite-field rotation witness with two checkers and algebraic Euler lower bound. No independent external audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only H(8,3) and orientable genus; no general claim for H(n,k) or nonorientable embeddings. Finite checker covers the entire asserted graph, not parameter families.
title: A vertex-transitive quadrangulation and exact orientable genus of the bipartite Kneser graph \(H(8,3)\)
